description: This file manages the Redux state slice for 'views' in a web application, including actions, selectors, and update logic for BoardView objects.

methods.name: smartViewUpdate
methods.description: Optimizes updating a BoardView by reusing existing field values when they are equal, to prevent unnecessary re-renders.

methods.name: setCurrent
methods.description: Sets the current view ID in the state.

methods.name: updateViews
methods.description: Updates multiple views in the state, adding or deleting based on the view's deleteAt property.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Updates a single view in the state.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns a selector function to retrieve a specific BoardView by ID.

methods.name: getCurrentBoardViews
methods.description: Selector that retrieves all views for the current board, sorted by title.

methods.name: getCurrentView
methods.description: Selector that retrieves the currently selected view.

methods.name: getCurrentViewGroupBy
methods.description: Retrieves the group-by property of the current view within the current board.

methods.name: getCurrentViewDisplayBy
methods.description: Retrieves the date display property of the current view within the current board.
